components.css: .ds-input{height:56px;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:4px 12px;border:1px solid var(--input);border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground);font-family:var(--font-serif);font-size:16px;line-height:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs);transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)}:host-context(.dark) .ds-input{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--input) 30%,transparent)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--ring);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring) 50%,transparent)}.ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--destructive);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 20%,transparent)}:host-context(.dark) .ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 40%,transparent)}.ds-input:disabled{pointer-events:none;cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}@media(min-width:48rem){.ds-input{font-size:14px;line-height:20px}}

narrative.overview:
BazaarGhost pairs cream or charcoal backgrounds with orange actions, Averia Libre public-page typography, and existing hero emblems. Dense lists and restrained borders keep recordings and matchups readable.

This records the implemented system, not a redesign. Source authority is `app/globals.css`, `app/layout.tsx`, `components/ui`, and `components/navbar.tsx`. The landing implementation in `app/(app)/page.tsx` and `components/landing` extends that system. Its selected concept and exact copy remain in `.impeccable/surfaces/landing.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Cream and charcoal theme pairs with a shared orange accent.
Averia Libre on public pages and the wordmark.
Hairline dividers, compact controls, and tonal selection states.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Use semantic CSS properties so a component follows both existing themes.

dos: Do reuse the existing semantic colors, local typeface, logo, and hero emblems.
Do keep selected rows, hover states, and keyboard focus visually distinct.
Do preserve readable text in both themes when reusing orange actions.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent visual identity as part of a new page.
Don't turn a landing-specific composition or deferred animation into a global rule.
